content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026 Overview
CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment includes Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator District vacancies across different districts of Assam.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The minimum age required is 18 years or above . Candidates should have any one of the following qualifications: 12th (Intermediate/Senior Secondary) Matriculation + 2 Years ITI Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a testing and certifying agency authorized by UIDAI for delivering Aadhaar services. Basic computer skills.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Salary
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will receive remuneration as per the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower .

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification mentions eligibility requirements and certification-related conditions. Candidates must have the required Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certification issued by a UIDAI-authorized agency.

content_sections.heading: Certification Requirements for Aadhaar Supervisor
content_sections.text: Candidates can appear for the Aadhaar Supervisor exam through the UIDAI-authorized examination portal. After applying for the exam, an authorization request is sent to the State Team. Candidates can appear for the exam after approval. Candidates can also complete Aadhaar LMS Certification after their LMS ID and password are created and approved.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: VLEs are not eligible to apply for this position. The recruitment is purely contractual for one year. Candidates must fulfil the UIDAI certification requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility criteria and required Aadhaar certification. Prepare the required details and documents. Visit the CSC recruitment portal. Complete the application process. Submit the application before 3 October 2026.
